A call that changes something reaches a reconnecting member even when the member's address refuses the connection.

**Adopting apps:**

- **Moving up:** `go get github.com/junkerderprovinz/parleyport@v1.3.8`. Nothing else changes for an app.
- **Retrying calls yourself:** an app that still tries a POST again after `group.ErrUnreachable` while a member reconnects, such as when it opens a member right after a join, can drop that retry. `Group.Call` rides out the reconnect for every method when the call never left this instance.
- **Plugins:** nothing to do.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A POST reaches a reconnecting member whose address refuses the call.** While a member is off the relay for a moment, as after a join, a re-open or a change of name or address, a call goes to the address it announced. When nothing took connections there, v1.3.7 tried a GET or HEAD again until the member was back, but a POST ended at once with `group.ErrUnreachable`, so an action started in that moment failed. A refused connection never carried any of the call, so `Group.Call` now tries it again for any method within the same three seconds, and the call reaches the member once. A call that went out in full and lost its answer still goes out again only as GET or HEAD.
